title: Groundnut — Fertilizer and Nutrient Management
content:
FERTILIZER RECOMMENDATION FOR GROUNDNUT:

BASAL DOSE (at sowing, in furrow):
- Nitrogen (N): 25 kg/ha
- Phosphorus (P2O5): 50 kg/ha
- Potassium (K2O): 50 kg/ha
(As 110 kg SSP/ha + 50 kg MOP/ha + 55 kg urea/ha)

IMPORTANT: Groundnut is a legume — NO top dressing of nitrogen is recommended as it fixes its own nitrogen via Rhizobium.

GYPSUM APPLICATION (Critical):
- Apply gypsum 500 kg/ha at pegging stage (30-35 DAS).
- Gypsum provides calcium and sulfur essential for pod filling.
- DO NOT skip gypsum — it is specific to groundnut.

MICRONUTRIENTS:
- Zinc: ZnSO4 @ 25 kg/ha as basal if zinc-deficient soils.
- Boron: Borax 1 kg/ha if boron deficiency observed.
- Use SSP preferred over DAP (SSP supplies sulfur which groundnut needs).

FOLIAR NUTRITION:
- 2% KNO3 spray at 35 DAS + 60 DAS for pod filling enhancement.
- DAP 2% foliar spray if yellowing observed during vegetative stage.

SOIL REQUIREMENTS:
- Best yield in well-drained red sandy loam or light textured soils.
- pH 6.0–7.5 optimal. Avoid waterlogged heavy clay soils.
- Organic carbon > 0.5% improves yield significantly.

KARNATAKA-SPECIFIC:
- UAS Dharwad recommends: N:25, P:50, K:50 kg/ha + gypsum 500 kg/ha.
- In Raichur zone: additional micronutrient spray (ZnSO4 0.5%) at 30 DAS recommended.
